bio: Offering a seamless dining experience as intriguing as its name, this comfortable haven blends together creativity, attention to detail, and charm. Chef Taylor Stark and his team stitch together an ambitious multicourse menu from culinary influences near and far. The meal starts with a trio of canapés utilizing product trim, making a clear statement about the kitchen’s sustainable gastronomy efforts. From there, meals may include a Berkshire pork dumpling with a turmeric and dill broth, inspired by the flavors of Chiang Mai, or velvety Colorado bison loin plated with apricot and grilled zucchini glazed with a dried shrimp caramel.A rigorous commitment to local sourcing as well as gorgeously manicured presentations underpin these far-flung creations.
